authorization: User requested cumulative two epochs, full validation, and batch128; migrate saved batch64 prefix, then batch128.
execution: Two concurrent independent A100-40GB jobs, one GPU per model; H200 app stopped.
initialization: Fresh DiT with adaLN-Zero and zero output head; frozen pretrained Prithvi; UNet weights incompatible

forward_process.flow: x_t=(1-t)*noise+t*x0; t uniform[0,1); independent noise/data pairing; target x0-noise
forward_process.epsilon: VP Gaussian; 1000 linear beta 1e-6..0.01; uniform discrete timesteps; target noise

sampler.flow: Euler from t=0 to t=1, exact NFE; final residual clipped to [-1,1] only
sampler.epsilon: Deterministic DDIM, exact NFE; x0 clip and consistent epsilon recomputation

scope: Two cumulative epochs; inherited batch64 prefix followed by batch128. Full141711 validation at each epoch end; no test.

architecture_notes.qk_norm: Per-head RMSNorm on Q and K, fp32 statistics, shared learned gain across heads; default SDPA 1/sqrt(head_dim) scaling. Not the original L2-normalized QKNorm variant.
architecture_notes.rope: Axial 2D RoPE in DiT self-attention only; replaces additive sinusoidal positions. Cross-attention retains Prithvi positional features without a second rotary transform.
architecture_notes.attention_backend: PyTorch SDPA; backend chosen by device/dtype, Flash kernel not guaranteed.

loss: Both valid-mask per-record MSE, then equal average across records

probe.purpose: hardware and finite-gradient check, not accuracy comparison

hardware_feasibility.measured_scope: Cached real HLC train batches; full training not started

learning_rate_extension: Sample-count warmup320000 followed by cosine decay to5217544 records; peak learning rate unchanged.
ema_notes: At batch128 decay is squared relative to batch64 for the same per-record EMA horizon; partial batches exponentiate decay by actual_records/128.
updates_definition: Per variant: inherited updates + ceil((2608772-inherited_offset)/128) + 20382 for epoch2; never count source-prefix samples again.
